## Frequently Asked Questions

What areas do you serve for corporate event management?
▼

We provide corporate event management, team-building services, and travel solutions across India and internationally.

Do you arrange travel and accommodation for delegates?
▼

Yes, we handle flights/trains, hotels, local transfers, visas and all travel logistics for corporate clients coming to or from any city in India.

Can you design custom team building activities?
▼

Absolutely. We create tailored team building programs to match your objectives, whether indoors, outdoors, adventure-based or soft-skill focused—within Delhi NCR or at offsite locations.

How much notice do you need to plan an event in Delhi?
▼

For large corporate events, ideally 3-6 months ahead; for smaller events or team building, 4-8 weeks usually works.

What are your safety & health protocols?
▼

We follow all local regulations, ensure hygiene, vetted vendors, insurance & first aid support, crowd control, and ensure safety standards in travel and event venues.

What corporate event management services do you offer in Delhi / NCR?
▼

We provide end-to-end corporate event management in Delhi NCR, including venue selection, event design & theme, logistics, audio-visual setup, decoration, catering, staffing, on-site coordination, and post-event evaluation. Our local knowledge ensures you get the best venues and suppliers in the National Capital Region at competitive rates.

Do you organise corporate travel and accommodation for out-of-town clients or delegates?
▼

Yes, as part of our corporate travel services, we handle flight / train bookings, ground transport, hotel accommodation, visas (if required), and logistics for delegates travelling to and from Delhi or any other city / country. We arrange everything so clients can focus on their event agenda without worrying about travel hassles.

Can you plan team building activities for companies operating in any other city of India?
▼

Definitely. We design and execute team building programs in Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, and across PAN India. Whether indoor or outdoor, adventure-based or soft-skills oriented, we tailor activities to your objectives (improving communication, leadership, bonding, etc.) and location.

How far in advance should I book an event in any city to ensure best options?
▼

For major corporate events in cities like Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, etc., it’s best to plan at least 2-4 months in advance, especially if you're targeting premium venues or peak seasons. For smaller team building or travel logistics, 1-2 months may suffice. Early booking helps with better pricing, availability, and smoother execution.

What are your pricing models / how much does corporate event management cost in Delhi?
▼

Cost depends on scale, venue, number of guests, duration, travel requirements, and services chosen (e.g. event design, technology, travel). For Delhi NCR, we offer custom quotes; as ballpark figures, a mid-sized one-day corporate event with local venue and basic AV & decor may start around ₹1 Lakh to ₹ 20 lakh. After understanding your needs, we’ll provide a detailed proposal.

What safety and health protocols do you follow for in-person events in Delhi / India?
▼

We follow all relevant local health and safety guidelines (including government / municipal regulations), ensure venue hygiene, provide medical / first-aid support, manage crowd control, etc. Depending on the current public health situation, we adapt protocols (e.g. sanitization, check-ins, distancing) to keep participants safe.

Can you handle international delegates / corporate clients coming from abroad?
▼

Yes, for international delegates we assist with travel logistics, accommodation, visa assistance, airport transfers, local insurance, and other necessary services. If delegates are coming to Delhi / India, we ensure all arrangements are smooth and compliant with local rules.

What kinds of team building experiences do you offer and where?
▼

We offer a variety of team building experiences: adventure / outdoor (trekking, ropes courses, obstacle challenges), indoor workshops (communication, trust, leadership), corporate retreats, experiential learning, gamified challenges. Locations include hill stations in PAN India, resorts, corporate campuses, hotels, and city-based venues.

How do you ensure quality / what is your experience / track record in Pan India?
▼

We have successfully managed 1000+ corporate events, 500+ teambuilding programs, and corporate travel itineraries for domestic and international clients. We maintain strong vendor relationships and use post-event feedback to continuously improve. We also show case studies / testimonials to demonstrate our delivery capabilities.

What is the process after I reach out for a quote ?
▼

Once you contact us, we do a discovery call / meeting to understand your objectives, guest numbers, budget, preferred dates, location. Then we draft a proposal including venue options, activities, travel plan (if needed), cost estimates. After your approval, we move to detailed planning, implementation, and on-site execution. Post-event, we do a review and gather feedback.

How do I choose the right venue in India for my corporate event or team building?
▼

Key factors include location accessibility, capacity, facilities (AV, staging, backup power), ambiance, accommodation (if needed), permissions / licenses, services (catering, decor), cost, safety, tech support, and flexibility. We help you evaluate potential venues in India or other countries, arrange site visits (virtually or physically), and negotiate contracts.

How do you handle corporate travel cancellations or changes?
▼

We build in contingency plans. For travel/transport/hotel bookings, we use flexible booking options where possible, monitor travel advisories (especially for international or interstate travel), include buffer times. If last-minute changes occur, we manage the required rebookings and communication. Our team is proactive in handling changes.

What extras / add-ons can you arrange for corporate events / travel?
▼

We can arrange extras like event branding, entertainment (live music, DJ, performers), welcome kits / swag, transport for guests, photography / videography, post-event reports, event apps, virtual reality / technology enhancement. For travel clients, we can arrange guided tours, cultural experiences, local transportation, cruise etc.
